overall_assessment: Top-level boundaries and learning-outcome groups generally survive, but controls repeatedly lose prerequisites, retain assessment logistics or misfile mandatory coursework. Both long reading-list flags are valid bibliographies, Design Studio's leak is real at the track level, and VALG3's blob reflects the source layout with teaching methods embedded in course content. The review included all 20 packet entries and the omitted tails of capped excerpts.

findings.evidence:
Generell adgangsinformasjon for emnet
Bestått alle emner i GK1 og GK2. Bestått studiodelen av GK3 og GK4.
findings.description: The extractor drops required prior courses or completed credits under AHO's Norwegian and English access headings. Six controls lack a prerequisite row despite such requirements. Design Studio also loses the general foundation-course requirement while retaining track prerequisites.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: AHO's section_headings leaves Generell adgangsinformasjon for emnet and Admission requirements unmapped. sectionize() discards their blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: Map both AHO headings to .admission. Extend .admission_prerequisites() for AHO's standalone spaced course codes and English completion wording. Keep sentences that combine admission with an explicit prior-course requirement and drop standalone application, eligibility and progression text.

findings.description: Design Studio's flag is a true positive. The uncapped section contains the Service Design track's LEARNING OUTCOMES line. The track's course activities and evaluation criteria also remain in course_content alongside the separately extracted course-level sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: AHO's reader reports the outer Course description heading but does not promote the track's inline labels to section boundaries.
findings.suggested_fix: Within the AHO Course description track blocks, recognize the exact inline labels EXPECTED OUTCOME, LEARNING OUTCOMES, COURSE ACTIVITIES and EVALUATION. Route the text to the corresponding canonical section and keep the track name with it. Reset to course_content at the next track or COURSE CONTENT label.

findings.evidence: Kurset er lagt opp som et verkstedkurs for koding, hvor studentene øves i teknologiske verktøy og ferdigheter.
findings.description: VALG3's blob flag reflects a long source description and correctly separated top-level outcomes and assessment. It also points to a real omission: the empty teaching heading yields no row even though the description specifies workshops, lectures and exercises. GK3 Arkitekturhistorie 2 likewise leaves its stated lecture format in course_content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: AHO's heading-based mapping keeps delivery descriptions inside Emnets innhold when there is no populated teaching block.
findings.suggested_fix: For AHO plans with an absent or empty teaching block, route whole sentences matching the observed delivery-form leads, such as Kurset er lagt opp som et verkstedkurs and Kurset er strukturert som en forelesningsrekke, from course_content into teaching_methods.

findings.description: An exercise portfolio stays in assessment alongside a separately graded home exam, and the presentation and process-sketchbook requirements in Post-growth stay beside the final assessment folder. Industridesign also leaves attendance and absence documentation that gate receipt of a semester grade in assessment. In ACDL Venues the gate body moves, leaving its heading behind.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: AHO does not enable section_inline_coursework for assessment, so .split_inline_coursework() handles individual gate sentences but misses several heading-led blocks and grade-eligibility wordings.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable section_inline_coursework for AHO. Extend the gate rules for the observed labels and For å få semesterkarakter eligibility phrasing, and keep adjacent absence documentation with the gate. Stop at Vurderingsform or Form of assessment, preserve explicitly graded participation, and move or remove orphaned gate labels.

Assignments

Preparation of Reading list. Minimum 50 titles by January 14, 2026
findings.description: Apparatus: Reading extracts a requirement to complete assignments, but leaves the actual assignment list in teaching_methods. The two Industridesign plans move the explicit attendance sentence while leaving the high-attendance and own-effort condition in teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The teaching-side inline splitter treats Assignments as a general teaching label and does not carry the adjacent list forward from the compulsory-activities block. Its attendance rules miss the forutsetning for gjennomføring wording.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat an AHO Assignments block as coursework when it follows a compulsory-activities block that explicitly requires assignment completion. Extend the teaching-side attendance rule to recognize høyt oppmøte stated as a forutsetning for gjennomføring.

findings.description: The same attendance requirement appears twice in one coursework_requirements row because the plan states it separately under teaching and examination.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The two inline splits append the identical sentence to the same destination through .append_section(), after the earlier block-level deduplication.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate exact normalized coursework paragraphs after all inline moves and preserve first occurrence and verbatim text.

findings.evidence: The course is organized through dialogue-driven seminars/workshops in which the discussions centre on each candidate’s research topics, methods, and challenges.
findings.description: The same sentence appears verbatim in course_content and teaching_methods. It describes the teaching method.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-based extraction keeps the repeated sentence in both sections. Cleanup only compares whole section rows.
findings.suggested_fix: For AHO, remove an exact normalized teaching-method sentence from course_content when the same full sentence is already present in teaching_methods.

findings.evidence: Besvarelsen leveres i Wiseflow. Du må gjøre deg kjent med innlogging og innleveringsmåte i forkant av frist for innlevering av besvarelse.
findings.description: Assessment retains submission systems, deadlines and examiner arrangements. Diploma teaching_methods also retains an exam-withdrawal deadline and withdrawal instructions. These logistics sit beside valid design or teaching text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: There is no AHO-specific cleanup for the sentence and paragraph forms of these notices.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrow AHO cleanup patterns for the observed WISEflow instructions, deadline sentences, examiner-only sentences and diploma withdrawal dates. Remove exam-system phrases from mixed sentences while preserving exam duration, format, aids and source-use rules.

findings.evidence: The students will need to buy materials. Depending on what you already have available, the expenses will be about 1500-3000,-.
findings.description: Materials expenses and excursion payment arrangements are included in otherwise substantive teaching methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The prose is inside a mapped Teaching block and no AHO cleanup removes standalone expense sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip AHO's observed materials-purchase, expense and excursion-payment sentences from teaching_methods. Preserve the underlying studio activities, excursion and alternative learning task.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The placeholder matcher does not cover these two AHO formulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Add whole-row matches for Pensumlisten publiseres i Leganto and Litteraturliste vil være tilgjengelig i Leganto, allowing terminal punctuation.
